description_zh: 调用DescribeForwardEntryAttribute查询指DNAT规则的明细信息
name: DescribeForwardEntryAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DNAT entry
parameters.name: forward_entry_id

ExternalIp.description_en: The Elastic IP Address (EIP) that provides public network access in the DNAT entry
ExternalIp.description_zh: DNAT条目中提供公网访问的弹性公网IP地址

ExternalPort.description_en:
The external port or port range for port forwarding.

The port range must be between 1 and 65535.

To forward a port range, separate the start and end ports with a forward slash (/), such as 10/20
ExternalPort.description_zh:
需要进行端口转发的外部端口或端口段。
输入的端口范围需要在1~65535之间。
如果需要在端口段内转发，请在输入时以正斜线（/）隔开起始端口，例如10/20

ForwardEntryId.description_en: The ID of the DNAT entry

ForwardEntryName.description_en: The name of the DNAT entry

HealthCheckPort.description_en: The probe port for DNAT. It must fall within the internal port range. The default value is empty
HealthCheckPort.description_zh: DNAT的探测端口，需要在内网端口范围内。默认值为空

InternalIp.description_en: The private IP address of the instance that communicates over the public network through the DNAT entry
InternalIp.description_zh: 通过DNAT条目进行公网通信的实例的私网IP地址

InternalPort.description_en:
The internal port or port range for port forwarding.

The port range must be between 1 and 65535.

To forward a port range, separate the start and end ports with a forward slash (/), such as 10/20
InternalPort.description_zh:
进行端口转发的内部端口或端口段。

输入的端口范围需要在1~65535之间。
如果需要在端口段内转发，请在输入时以正斜线（/）隔开起始端口，例如10/20

IpProtocol.description_en:
The protocol type. Valid values:

TCP: Forwards TCP messages.

UDP: Forwards UDP messages.

Any: Forwards messages of all protocols
IpProtocol.description_zh:
协议类型，取值：

TCP：转发TCP协议的报文。

UDP：转发UDP协议的报文。

Any：转发所有协议的报文

NatGatewayId.description_en: The ID of the NAT Gateway

StandbyExternalIp.description_en: The standby Elastic IP Address (EIP) that provides public network access. You must select a standby EIP attached to the NAT Gateway. The standby public IP becomes active after the DNAT entry is created
StandbyExternalIp.description_zh: 提供公网访问的备用弹性公网IP地址，需要选择绑定在NAT上的备用弹性IP。DNAT创建成功后，备用公网IP会生效

StandbyStatus.description_en:
The status of the standby EIP.

Running: Enabled.

Stopping: Being disabled.

Stopped: Disabled.

Starting: Being enabled
StandbyStatus.description_zh:
备用EIP状态。
Running：开启。
Stopping：关闭中。
Stopped：关闭。
Starting：启动中

Status.description_en:
The status of the DNAT entry.

Pending: The configuration is in progress, such as during creation or modification.

Available: The entry is active.

Deleting: The entry is being deleted
Status.description_zh:
DNAT条目状态。
Pending：配置中，可能是创建中或修改中。
Available：可用。
Deleting：删除中
